Present for sixteen years, it affects numerous applications using the MagicYUV decoder. Exploitation requires only a crafted media file. Users are advised to check for the vulnerability and apply patches or disable the decoder if necessary. By Olimpiu Pop

highlights: Schwachstelle 'PixelSmash' ermöglicht Remote Code Execution.
